name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.185: The audio fit now says what it did at the normal log level instead of only in the
    per-file detail. The run's start line names the switch (audio fit=on/off) and the run's closing
    line carries the counter (N fitted to audio), so a fit that ran is distinguishable from a fit
    that had nothing to do — without raising the log level. The per-file detail keeps the facts
    needed to reproduce a fit: which audio track was read and which subtitle it was fitted against.
    Also counts the hearing-impaired track, which goes through the same correction and was missing
    from the counter, and drops a log branch that had no effect.
